headlines.text: Looking back to 2025, when history was made as Mercedes Mone vs. Mina Shirakawa contested the very first AEW TBS Title match, appearing on WrestleDream, rated 6.41. Mon? defeated Mina Shirakawa to retain the TBS Championship and win the interim ROH Women's World TV Title, capping a whirlwind week that saw her add four championships in three countries.

Rewind to 2022, when the AEW World Heavyweight Title was up for grabs as Jon Moxley vs. Adam Page went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.84. It was the 30th time the AEW World Heavyweight Title had been on the line, a significant milestone for the title. Adam Page was chasing gold for the 10th time. Moxley's World Title defense against Page turned brutally physical and ended early after a legitimate concussion from a clothesline forced the referee to stop the match
On this day in 2023, it was a welcome sight as Emi Sakura returned to the ring after 7 weeks away, appearing on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2025, Brodido vs. Okada & Takeshita went to battle over the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on WrestleDream, rated 8.93 ? a genuine showstealer. Okada & Takeshita was challenging for gold for the very first time. Brodido retained the AEW World Tag Team Titles over Okada and Takeshita, with cracks showing in the Don Callis Family as Takeshita walked off frustrated by Okada's attitude.

Flash back to 2025, when Kyle Fletcher vs. Mark Briscoe clashed for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on WrestleDream, rated 8.34 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle. Fletcher retained the TNT Championship over Briscoe in a 24-minute battle, extending his reign as one of the Don Callis Family's top stars.

On this day in 2025, Darby Allin vs. Jon Moxley fought it out in an I Quit match, in the night's main event on WrestleDream, rated 8.12 ? a genuinely great match ? part of a stacked WrestleDream '25 card, rated 8.20 overall. With help from his old tag partner Sting, Allin defeated Moxley in a brutal "I Quit" match to deal a major blow to the Death Riders.
